verdict: Yes, with a fit that works for Indian bodies. Fitkin pitched women's activewear on Shark Tank India Season 5 and got a deal. Yoga, gym and walking have made activewear everyday clothing, but Decathlon and big brands keep prices low.
angle: Activewear is worn every day, not just at the gym, and women look for squat-proof, sweat-wicking fabric in Indian sizes. Community workouts, trainers and yoga studios are the best channels. Fabric quality decides repeat purchases.
